_comment: The desk's rules as worked examples, shared with the C# repositories. This is the canonical copy: claude-code-governed-workflow owns the rules (openspec/specs/response-deadline). ticket-intake-service and mcp-server-dotnet each hold a copy under their tests' Fixtures folder and fail if the code disagrees with it. Change the rules here, then copy this file; never edit a copy. Worked out by hand from the spec, not generated from the code. The cases use only what all three repositories have: no security category and no public holidays, which only this repository knows.

priority.case: an outage on the enterprise plan
an outage on the starter plan
an outage with no plan recorded
an outage reported as a bug

deadline.case: urgent, opened mid-morning on a Monday
urgent, opened late on a Friday
high, opened exactly at closing time
low, forty hours is five whole days
normal, opened half an hour before the weekend
